messages.content: Read only the requested local fields from the current supplied text. For each known field select the supplied span IDs that support its value. The host binds these IDs to exact source text; do not rewrite or quote the source. Citation fields use full literal citation strings in the headings; a legacy label-ID output sentence is only an encoding instruction. Respect the question scope and roles. Never use old-source values. Use status unknown with value null if the current material is insufficient. Do not answer the entire task unless a requested field itself is that native label.

{"task": {"dataset": "SARA_v2_Binary", "view_id": "native", "source_spans": [{"id": 0, "field": "source_text", "start": 0, "end": 38, "text": "§7703. Determination of marital status"}, {"id": 1, "field": "source_text", "start": 40, "end": 56, "text": "(a) General rule"}, {"id": 2, "field": "source_text", "start": 62, "end": 292, "text": "(1) the determination of whether an individual is married shall be made as of the close of his taxable year; except that if his spouse dies during his taxable year such determination shall be made as of the time of such death; and"}, {"id": 3, "field": "source_text", "start": 298, "end": 438, "text": "(2) an individual legally separated from his spouse under a decree of divorce or of separate maintenance shall not be considered as married."}, {"id": 4, "field": "source_text", "start": 440, "end": 484, "text": "(b) Certain married individuals living apart"}, {"id": 5, "field": "source_text", "start": 486, "end": 568, "text": "For purposes of those provisions of this title which refer to this subsection, if-"}, {"id": 6, "field": "source_text", "start": 574, "end": 916, "text": "(1) an individual who is married (within the meaning of subsection (a)) and who files a separate return maintains as his home a household which constitutes for more than one-half of the taxable year the principal place of abode of a child with respect to whom such individual is entitled to a deduction for the taxable year under section 151,"}, {"id": 7, "field": "source_text", "start": 922, "end": 1036, "text": "(2) such individual furnishes over one-half of the cost of maintaining such household during the taxable year, and"}, {"id": 8, "field": "source_text", "start": 1042, "end": 1151, "text": "(3) during the last 6 months of the taxable year, such individual's spouse is not a member of such household,"}, {"id": 9, "field": "source_text", "start": 1153, "end": 1205, "text": "such individual shall not be considered as married.\n"}, {"id": 10, "field": "referenced_public_sections", "start": 0, "end": 2356, "text": "{\"151\": \"§151. Allowance of deductions for personal exemptions\\n\\n(a) Allowance of deductions\\n\\nIn the case of an individual, the exemptions provided by this section shall be allowed as deductions in computing taxable income.\\n\\n(b) Taxpayer and spouse\\n\\nAn exemption of the exemption amount for the taxpayer; and an additional exemption of the exemption amount for the spouse of the taxpayer if a joint return is not made by the taxpayer and his spouse, and if the spouse, for the calendar year in which the taxable year of the taxpayer begins, has no gross income and is not the dependent of another taxpayer.\\n\\n(c) Additional exemption for dependents\\n\\nAn exemption of the exemption amount for each individual who is a dependent (as defined in section 152) of the taxpayer for the taxable year.\\n\\n(d) Exemption amount\\n\\nFor purposes of this section-\\n\\n    (1) In general\\n\\n    Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the term \\\"exemption amount\\\" means $2,000.\\n\\n    (2) Exemption amount disallowed in case of certain dependents\\n\\n    In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under this section is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins, the exemption amount applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall be zero.\\n\\n    (3) Phaseout\\n\\n        (A) In general\\n\\n        In the case of any taxpayer whose adjusted gross income for the taxable year exceeds the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b), the exemption amount shall be reduced by the applicable percentage.\\n\\n        (B) Applicable percentage\\n\\n        For purposes of subparagraph (A), the term \\\"applicable percentage\\\" means 2 percentage points for each $2,500 (or fraction thereof) by which the taxpayer's adjusted gross income for the taxable year exceeds the applicable amount in effect under section 68(b). In the case of a married individual filing a separate return, the preceding sentence shall be applied by substituting \\\"$1,250\\\" for \\\"$2,500\\\". In no event shall the applicable percentage exceed 100 percent.\\n\\n    (5) Special rules for taxable years 2018 through 2025\\n\\n    In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term \\\"exemption amount\\\" means zero.\\n\"}"}, {"id": 11, "field": "facts", "start": 0, "end": 133, "text": "Alice and Bob got married on April 5th, 2012. Alice and Bob were legally separated under a decree of divorce on September 16th, 2017."}, {"id": 12, "field": "question", "start": 0, "end": 54, "text": "Section 7703(a)(2) applies to Alice for the year 2018."}], "read_question": "Read the current task input fields.", "source_locator": "current supplied source, facts and question, according to each requested field", "fields": {"is_agricultural_labor": {"type": "boolean", "question": "Was the service for which the current payment was made agricultural labor?"}, "is_paid_in_non_cash_medium": {"type": "boolean", "question": "Was the current remuneration paid in a medium other than cash?"}}}, "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"is_agricultural_labor": {"type": "object", "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["known", "unknown"]}, "value": {"type": ["boolean", "null"]}, "support_ids": {"type": "array", "maxItems": 13, "items": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 12}}}, "required": ["status", "value", "support_ids"], "additionalProperties": false}, "is_paid_in_non_cash_medium": {"type": "object", "properties": {"status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["known", "unknown"]}, "value": {"type": ["boolean", "null"]}, "support_ids": {"type": "array", "maxItems": 13, "items": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 12}}}, "required": ["status", "value", "support_ids"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "required": ["is_agricultural_labor", "is_paid_in_non_cash_medium"], "additionalProperties": false}}
